//: The Amazon registry this list started from (amazon.de/registries/gl/guest-view/1MQ0E43354VFG), read on 2026-10-19. Imported once by an editor from the empty list; source_key makes a second run a no-op. Notes are the owner's own, verbatim.

items.name: Pasta strainer
items.note: Any sort of stainless steel sifter would do!

items.name: Kitchen utensil set
items.note: Any stainless steel utensil set would work, please pay attention to reviews regarding longevity. Storage is nice, but not a must

items.name: Potato masher
items.note: Any stainless steel potato masher thingy would work, again looking for longevity and quality

items.name: Glass measuring cup
items.note: Any heat resistant, glass measuring cup would do. No plastic please. NOTE: Way cheaper in TK Maxx, for my German friendsies

items.name: Toaster
items.note: Any stainless steel or black cute Toaster would work, with minimal plastic and toxins

items.name: Knife block
items.note: Any high quality knife block would work, I like the aesthetic of this one and the reviews

items.name: Kitchen recycling bin
items.note: Any bin with at least 2 compartments would work, not high volume of litres please, I’m a single household after all😆

items.name: Mop and bucket
items.note: Any convenient mop works, which wrings the wet mop automatically

items.name: Swiffer duster
items.note: I’ll take all the cleaning supplies I can get, so thank youuuu

items.name: Contact grill
items.note: Any sort of sandwich / opti grill that is not in those triangle shapes and has NO TEFLON, only ceramics coating would work

items.name: Toolbox
items.note: Any sort of toolbox works; I would also enjoy a hand-me-down if anyone has a spare

items.name: Red wine glasses
items.note: I like the thinness of the stem, any thin crisp crystal glass that can go into a dishwasher works, but PLEASE no elephant stems, a stem so skinny it looks like it would break just by touching it is the goal

items.name: Air fryer
items.note: Same game here, any air fryer that does not have teflon or non stick other than ceramic works. My household will be as toxin free as possible, so excuse the inconvenience mwah

items.name: Mixing bowls with lids
items.note: Any stainless steel bowl set with a lid works, please make sure the inside of the bowl is brushed stainless Steel, so the matte looking stainless steel, because the shiny one will scratch like crazy.

items.name: Hand blender
items.note: Any stainless steel mixing wand would work, it just has to be stainless steel so it’s suitable for mixing hot soups and sauces

items.name: Spice jars with labels
items.note: Any glass spice jars would work, but please make sure they come with labels and more importantly a sifter thingy for easier dosage

items.name: Jemako cleaning cloths
items.note: Since my mom swears on these jemako cleaning towels, I’ll follow in the footsteps ;)

items.name: Tea towels
items.note: Some tea towels for cleaning and drying dishes would be lovely. Ideally cotton and if you find any cute rosy/pink ones that aren’t fluffy, I would love that as well

items.name: Guest towels
items.note: Guest towels in beige, brown or Baby pink would also work

items.name: Wooden cutting boards
items.note: Any 100% wooden cutting boards would work, ideally 2-3 as a set. Checkered wood is nice, but not a must. Anything you think I’d enjoy would work:)

items.name: Duvet
items.note: A nice fresh blanket made from natural materials like cotton and feathers would be lovely to have in a new apartment :)

items.name: Water filter for the Sage espresso machine
